refused: firewall: ufw is installed but not active, and admit found no port sshd listens on. It enables ufw only behind an allow for every one of them, so --enable-ufw refuses here too, and admit gives no commands to enable ufw by hand. Enabling ufw without an allow for your SSH port cuts off SSH to this host: allow the port your SSH server listens on with `sudo ufw allow <port>/tcp` before anything enables ufw, then run admit again. Nothing was changed
